name: Cryonax

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Shardstorm
traits.details: This aura is inactive within 10 squares of Cryonax. The active aura is difficult terrain and heavily obscured. Any enemy that ends its turn in the active aura takes 25 cold and thunder damage and, if flying, falls prone.

traits.name: Cold Absorption
traits.details: If Cryonax would take cold damage, he instead regains a number of hit points equal to that damage.

traits.name: Elemental Footing
traits.details: Cryonax ignores difficult terrain. If an attack would knock Cryonax prone, he can make a saving throw to avoid falling prone.

traits.name: Epic Resilience
traits.details: If Cryonax is dazed, dominated, petrified, stunned, or weakened, or knocked unconscious with 1 hit point or more remaining, he ignores the effects of the condition and instead grants combat advantage and gains vulnerable 10 to all damage for the condition’s duration.

traits.name: Frostbrittle
traits.details: If an enemy adjacent to Cryonax hits him with a melee attack, that enemy grants combat advantage and gains vulnerable 10 to all damage until the end of that enemy’s next turn.

traits.name: Threatening Reach
traits.details: Cryonax can make opportunity attacks against enemies within 5 squares of him.

auras.name: Shardstorm
auras.details: This aura is inactive within 10 squares of Cryonax. The active aura is difficult terrain and heavily obscured. Any enemy that ends its turn in the active aura takes 25 cold and thunder damage and, if flying, falls prone.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature, or two creatures when Cryonax is bloodied

effect.description: Until the end of Cryonax’s next turn, the attack creates a zone in a close burst 1 around the target’s square. Squares within the zone are lightly obscured. Any creature that ends its turn in the zone takes 25 cold and necrotic damage.

hit.description: cold and necrotic damage, and the target is slowed and weakened (save ends both).

failedSavingThrows.name: AverageDamage
failedSavingThrows.description: The target drops to 0 hit points.

effect.description: Any effect that renders Cryonax slowed, immobilized, or restrained ends, and he moves up to his speed. Each time Cryonax comes within 5 squares of an enemy for the first time during the move, he uses tentacle against that enemy.
